name: AriaOS Neural Clipboard & Smart Transformer
description: Persistent clipboard ring-buffer with semantic classification (JSON, URL, shell command, code, path) and 1-click formatting/transformation.

tools.name: clipboard_history
tools.description: Retrieve recent clipboard entries with semantic classification (JSON, URL, shell command, code, path, text).

tools.name: copy_to_clipboard
tools.description: Copy text to the OS clipboard and save it in AriaOS persistent clipboard history.

tools.name: transform_clipboard
tools.description: Transform the latest clipboard content (format_json, extract_urls, base64_encode, base64_decode, sha256_hash, uppercase, lowercase).

tools.name: clear_clipboard
tools.description: Wipe the system clipboard and clear AriaOS persistent clipboard history for privacy.
